risks.risk: Shutter count/actual usage level unknown, affecting remaining lifespan

proof_requests: A video or photo of the camera powered on, showing the LCD screen active and a test shot taken
A clear photo of the model number plate on the body (bottom or front) to confirm 'D3400' vs another Nikon model
A close-up of the lens glass (front and rear elements) against light to check for fungus/scratches
A photo of the shutter count or EXIF data from a sample image
Confirmation of brand/model consistency from the seller, resolving the Nikon/Canon discrepancy in the text
response.reason: Photos confirm a Nikon-branded entry-level DSLR body with a 70-300mm telephoto lens, but the model cannot be read with certainty, the seller's text contains a brand contradiction (Canon vs Nikon), and no working proof is shown, so it must be priced as an unverified, worst-case functioning entry-level Nikon DSLR with kit-level lens.
